Files are copied without modification. Only the C++ single-header loader is used.
`TINYOBJLOADER_IMPLEMENTATION` and `TINYOBJLOADER_DISABLE_FAST_FLOAT` are defined
in ObjLoader.cpp only; no extra dependency or network access is needed to build.
